technical.summary: Mixed short-term bullish technicals (RSI rising, supertrend, hull) conflicted by bearish MACD, price below 50-day averages, and weak trend strength (ADX 18.55); lacks confluence for high-probability swing entry.

fundamental.summary: ABT shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 19 days creating elevated event risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (VIX-equivalent 25) presents contrarian buy opportunity; congressional activity is mixed and low-conviction with no clear directional bias.

risk.summary: Crisis VIX (360.64), flat yield curve, rising dollar, and earnings in 19 days create a highly adverse macro backdrop for ABT.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price near support (99.491), supertrend bullish, short-term EMA alignment, and extreme fear (VIX crisis) create contrarian entry opportunity with defined risk.
debate.key_bear_argument: Earnings in 19 days, price below 50-day averages, MACD bearish, weak ADX trend strength, unfavorable macro (crisis VIX, rising dollar, flat yield curve), and zero fundamental conviction make this a high-risk, low-probability swing entry.

decision.entry_rationale: Price at support with short-term bullish technicals and extreme fear presents contrarian setup; however, earnings in 19 days, bearish MACD, price below 50-day averages, and weak trend strength (ADX 18.55) create unacceptable event risk for swing trade.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings announcement in 19 days will likely trigger gap move regardless of technical setup; macro headwinds (crisis VIX, rising dollar, flat yield curve) and zero fundamental conviction amplify downside exposure.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
